reviewedBy: Codex exact-three PAYE source and formula verifier
reason: Correct the Rwanda English and Swahili PAYE owners to apply mandatory CBHI at 0.5% of employee net salary, as stated in the RSSB employer notice and Prime Minister Order N° 034/01 Article 2(10). Because the notice does not specify payroll ordering or rounding, the calculator explicitly models a nearest-franc fixed point rather than presenting that implementation detail as statute. The RWF 300,000 oracle yields PAYE RWF 48,600, employee pension RWF 18,000, maternity RWF 900, CBHI RWF 1,157, net RWF 231,343 and employer cost RWF 324,900. The official 2% employer-only occupational-hazard contribution remains unchanged.
